text: Good morning. Further to the briefing of 2 November, please amend the layout of Polling Station 14 as follows. 1. The booth nearest the entrance is to be designated the accessible booth; kindly mark it as such and make it larger, as it must accommodate a wheelchair. 2. The ballot box must remain in full view of the Presiding Officer at all times. Please place a desk for the Presiding Officer immediately to the left of the ballot box, bearing the words "Presiding Officer". 3. Voters do not proceed directly from the identity check to the booths; they first collect a ballot paper at the issuing desk, which should be shown between those two points. I would be grateful if this could be completed before the layout is circulated to the poll clerks this afternoon.
